info.title: Adjustment Event API
info.description: DRAFT - NOT PUBLISHED. Backend API contract for the Web dashboard to append manual adjustment events to the append-only event store. Adjustments correct the real state shown on dashboards without modifying recorded history.

post.description: Appends a manual correction to the append-only event store. Never updates or deletes existing events.

400.description: Invalid request, e.g. a void without target_event_id or a compensation without corrected_fact

404.description: Referenced actor, target event, or beacon not found

VoidAdjustment.description: Marks one previously recorded event as erroneous. Projections skip the target event; the event itself stays in the store.

actor.description: Steward (android device) the adjustment is about.

target_event_id.description: The event being voided. May reference another adjustment.

reason.description: Mandatory human-readable justification for the correction.
reason.example: Duplicate disconnect caused by beacon signal loss at Norreport; steward never left the platform.

author.description: Admin who performed the adjustment, taken from the authenticated dashboard session.

CompensationAdjustment.description: Records the fact that actually happened, replacing or supplementing wrong or missing history.

actor.description: Steward (android device) the adjustment is about.

target_event_id.description: Optional link to the event this correction supersedes. Null when the adjustment has no single target. May reference another adjustment.

reason.description: Mandatory human-readable justification for the correction.
reason.example: Beacon never fired on arrival; steward confirms platform patrol 10:05-10:35.

author.description: Admin who performed the adjustment, taken from the authenticated dashboard session.

CorrectedFact.description: The event that actually happened, expressed in the same vocabulary as the ingestion events.

beacon_id.description: Required when fact_type is connect or disconnect, null otherwise.

occurred_at.description: When the corrected fact actually happened. UTC in ISO 8601 with offset.

AdjustmentEventStored.description: The adjustment as stored in the append-only event store.

adjustment_id.description: Server-generated identifier of the appended adjustment event.

server_timestamp.description: When the backend recorded the adjustment. UTC in ISO 8601 with offset.

message.description: Human-readable error message intended for developers
